wiki.title: Ami Bera
wiki.extract: Amerish Babulal "Ami" Bera ( AH-mee BERR-ə; born March 2, 1965) is an American physician and politician who has been serving as a member of the United States House of Representatives from California since 2013. He is a member of the Democratic Party and represents California's 6th congressional district, which is in Sacramento County.
